# KnowShowGo client

> JavaScript and Python SDKs for KnowShowGo, a knowledge graph service where every piece of information is a node with a permanent UUID, a version history that is never overwritten, provenance, an optional embedding, and typed edges. Categories are fuzzy prototypes, claims carry their source and resolve into beliefs, procedures are stored as graphs, and propositions can be evaluated against stored claims and audited. Hosted API: https://api.knowshowgo.com (bearer token for writes, from https://knowshowgo.com/developers). No delete exists; updates are new versions; an unknown answer is returned as unknown.

Install: `npm install @lehelkovach/knowshowgo-client` (Node 18+) or `pip install knowshowgo-client` (Python 3.8+). Until a registry version exists: `npm install git+https://github.com/lehelkovach/knowshowgo-client.git#dev`.

## Rules an agent should follow

- One client per human owner, with that owner's token; pass your agent name as `speaker` on writes.
- Never fabricate from the model what the graph does not hold; `unknown` is a valid answer.
- Never delete; retract a claim or write a new version.
- Send the full property set on every object version; a version is a snapshot, not a patch.
